rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making an earnest and persistent effort to achieve a goal.

example.english: We will strive to make this project a success.
example.traditional: 我哋會努力令呢個計劃成功。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 nou5 lik6 ling6 ne1 go3 gai3 waak6 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use this when the struggle is directed against an opponent, force, or fate.

example.english: We strive to fight the disease and will never give up.
example.traditional: 我哋一直對抗病魔，絕對唔會放棄。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 zik6 deoi3 kong3 beng6 mo1 zyut6 deoi3 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3

rows.note: Use this when striving means competing or contending with another person or group.

example.english: Several big companies strive to win this contract.
example.traditional: 幾間大公司都喺度競爭呢份合約。
example.jyutping: gei2 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 dou1 hai2 dou6 ging6 zang1 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3
